name: Calcite
notes: Ambient 24 C structure: Markgraf and Reeder, American Mineralogist 70, 590-600 (1985), COD 9000965. The EoS is from Redfern and Angel, Contributions to Mineralogy and Petrology 134, 102-106 (1999), doi:10.1007/s004100050471. Phase-line intensities were calculated from the cited structure using independent-atom X-ray form factors.
